text:
Logan Cooley has 23 points in 20 games, and 16 of them have come on the power play, which tells you where Utah runs its offense. He's back after a short absence (he returned against Vancouver on Nov. 16 and has an assist in each game since), and over his last ten he has 10 goals, including hat tricks against Pittsburgh and Montreal.

Our numbers call it real and inflated at once. Real, because the chances are there: 4.5 expected goals (the quality of his shots) over those ten games. Inflated, because 11 goals on 6.5 expected means he's shooting 32%, up from 24% last season. Nobody holds that. He's 18th of 547 skaters in wins added, so the goals have mattered.

The part that should travel is the puck carrying. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 56% of his entries and in the 85th percentile for primary shot assists among forwards. When the shooting cools, watch whether the setups keep coming.
headline: Cooley's finishing is running hot
